g.title: A Wails shell around the React UI. App.SendRequest in gostman-gui/app.go calls engine.Send in the same process, so there is no network hop and no CORS. It also reads and saves the workspace folder and starts the mock server and traffic capture.

The same React UI built with the web Vite config. lib/backend/web.js posts every request to /api/proxy, because browsers block cross-origin calls. WebSocket traffic goes straight from the browser, and scripts run in a fresh Web Worker each.

The Go runner package loads a collection, plans the run, and calls the bundled JavaScript inside goja for scripts, checks and extract rules. It sends through the engine, rpc or mcpclient and returns a report with an exit code.

Serves 17 tools such as send_request and run_folder over stdio or loopback HTTP with a bearer token, plus one tool per request tagged with --expose-tag. It wraps a runner session, fills secrets in only for hosts your own requests already call, and scrubs them from every reply.
Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, connected over the Model Context Protocol. It sees request ids, names and responses with secret values replaced by their names.

engine prepares and sends requests: variables, auth, body encoding, cookies, redirects, proxies and certificates for HTTP, GraphQL, SOAP, SSE, TCP, UDP and NATS. rpc handles gRPC and mcpclient handles MCP servers. The engine keeps no state between requests.
The workspace package reads a folder of plain YAML, one file per request. Tokens, cookies and history never go into it. A bounded reader pool opens 5,000 requests in 5.4 s, down from 14.8 s.
Any HTTP, gRPC, WebSocket, MQTT or MCP endpoint. There is no account and no telemetry, so nothing else is contacted for requests.

api/proxy.go takes an engine.Request as JSON and returns an engine.Response. Its hosted policy blocks private addresses, cuts responses at 3 MB and caps timeouts at 30 s. The same handler runs in gostman relay and gostman serve.
